player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop by repeatedly guessing the same word, "globe", even though the feedback indicated that it was not the correct word. What's worse, I didn't learn from my previous mistakes and didn't try to introduce new letters or positions for the correct letters. Next time, I will try to introduce new letters or positions for the correct letters 'g', 'l', and 'o' in each guess, and avoid repeating the same word. For example, if I keep 'g', 'l', and 'o' in the correct positions, I can try to introduce a new letter in a different position, or try a different word that includes these letters in the correct positions.
